ValidationRule.description: Code serial must be zero-padded to 4 digits, may not be a non-zero palindrome, and zero serials are Draft-only.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( REGEX(Code__c, 'PRJ-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[A-Z]{2}'), OR( LPAD(TEXT(VALUE(MID(Code__c, 10, 4))), 4, '0') <> MID(Code__c, 10, 4), AND(MID(Code__c, 10, 4) = REVERSE(MID(Code__c, 10, 4)), VALUE(MID(Code__c, 10, 4)) > 0), AND(VALUE(MID(Code__c, 10, 4)) = 0, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Draft'))), RPAD(RIGHT(Code__c, 2), 4, '*') <> RPAD(UPPER(RIGHT(Code__c, 2)), 4, '*') ), FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Code serial is not zero-padded, is a palindrome, or is 0000 on a non-draft project.
